name: Muesli
description: Raw oats with dried fruit, nuts and seeds — soaked overnight, or eaten dry.

tcm.note: Read with oats and dried fruit.

ayurveda.note: Nuts and dried fruit are ushna.

histamine.note: The dried fruit and nuts carry it, not the oats.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
